Container.Name: filearr
Container.Overview:
Unified media catalog and typo-tolerant search over mixed libraries (video, music, audiobooks, samples, images, 3D models, documents, spreadsheets). Scans filesystems directly; Postgres is the source of truth, Meilisearch a rebuildable search projection. Public REST API for search and metadata updates.
REQUIRES: the filearr-postgres and filearr-meilisearch containers (install first), and a user-defined Docker network named 'filearr' so containers resolve each other by name. Create it once in the Unraid terminal: docker network create filearr
First start bootstraps the database automatically (idempotent; waits for Postgres). Set FILEARR_AUTO_INIT_DB=false to manage migrations manually.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Media library root (read-only; filearr never modifies files in v1)

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: SQLAlchemy DSN (psycopg driver). Password must match filearr-postgres.

Config.Name: Procrastinate DSN
Config.Description: Plain Postgres DSN for the job queue (same DB, no driver prefix)

Config.Name: Auth Enabled
Config.Description: Login + API auth (default on; first visit shows the create-admin screen). Set false only on a fully trusted LAN.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Envelope key encrypting alert-channel secrets (SMTP/webhook credentials). Optional until you use alerts (the API returns 503 without it). Generate: openssl rand -hex 32. Never rotate once set.

Config.Name: Recycle Retention Days
Config.Description: Days trashed items are kept before scheduled purge
